jobs.description: The Billion-Dollar Rescue | Volumez Case Study Case Studies / Industries The Billion-Dollar Rescue The "Zero-Hour" Threat Hunter The "Time-Travel" Quality Guardian The “Day-Zero” Perception Leap The "Instant" Fraud & AML Sentinel The Wildfire & Outage Prevention Commander About Us Block Solution Careers Contact Us Get a Demo Get a Demo Pharmaceutical R&D The Billion-Dollar Rescue The agent mission Save a failing $2B cancer trial. Find a hidden root cause for severe side effects buried between millions of genomic data points and thousands of handwritten doctor’s notes before the program is shut down This investigation has to move from hypothesis to proof in days: identify the patient cohorts impacted, pinpoint the causal factor (interaction, dosing window, comorbidity, or protocol deviation), and produce a regulator-ready evidence bundle that traces every conclusion back to raw sources. The Challenge The Great Divide Clinical research data is split across structured systems (LIMS, EDC, genomics pipelines, imaging metadata, adverse event tables) and unstructured clinical context (physician notes, narratives, scanned PDFs, and handwritten annotations). The hard part isn’t just ingestion—it’s joining these worlds on patient, visit, and time, while dealing with inconsistent identifiers and missing fields. Black Box The highest-signal clues often live in “dark data”: PDFs, scans, and free text that SQL engines can’t reason over. Without automated text extraction and semantic indexing, teams fall back to manual review, which destroys speed and reproducibility. Paralysis by Volume At trial scale, even a small hypothesis (e.g., a supplement interaction) can require correlating genomics, lab deltas, dosing, and narrative symptoms across tens of thousands of pages. Manual cross-referencing becomes a months-long effort—exactly when the program needs a two‑week turnaround FDA Rigor A “likely cause” isn’t enough. You need traceability: which records were used, which transformations occurred, what filters were applied, and how each claim maps to the original note, timestamp, and patient context—so the result stands up to internal review and external audit. How Volumez Agentic Data Platform solves this Unlocking Text Volumez Agentic Infrastructure ingests PDFs, scans, and handwritten notes and turns them into queryable, governed artifacts—extracted text, entities (drug, dosage, supplement, symptom), and vector indexes for semantic retrieval. Agents can retrieve relevant passages instantly while preserving a citation trail back to the source document. The "Impossible" Join Volumez Agentic Data Platform correlates structured biology (genomics variants, biomarkers, lab time-series) with unstructured clinical language (symptom descriptions, physician impressions, concomitant meds) using deterministic keys (patient/visit/time) plus semantic matching. This enables fast cohort slicing and root-cause isolation without losing provenance. Automated Cartography Volumez Agentic Data Platform auto-discovers schemas and relationships across fragmented datasets: it profiles columns, detects join candidates, flags quality issues, and builds a searchable catalog. The agent gets an instant “map” of the research space—what data exists, how it connects, and what’s trustworthy—without weeks of manual modeling. In-Place Deep Thought Instead of exporting data into separate analytics stacks, Volumez Agentic Data Platform runs large scans and repeated hypothesis tests close to the data. That supports rapid iteration—testing many hypotheses quickly—while minimizing data movement, cost, and time-to-answer. Take agentic to a whole new level. The Challenge The "Social-Telco" Gap Signals are split across consumer platforms (social media, messaging exports) and telco/geo telemetry (CDRs, tower metadata, location pings). These sources rarely share clean identifiers, and correlation is time-sensitive—small delays can mean the network vanishes. Graph Paralysis Mapping multi-hop relationships from billions of events is computationally heavy. Traditional pipelines build graphs offline in batch, producing results that are stale by the time analysts see them. Unstructured Blindness Screenshots, images, and free-form chat content often carry the key context (landmarks, insignias, coded language). Conventional tools treat this as opaque attachments, so critical links never make it into the analysis. Needle in Haystack Operationally, you’re searching for rare patterns: a burner phone, a coordinator node, or a transient meeting—hidden among massive daily interaction volume. Without high-speed correlation and ranking, analyst time is spent chasing noise. How Volumez Agentic Data Platform solves this Total Digital Ingestion Volumez Agentic Infrastructure unifies social scrapes, message exports, and telco/CDR feeds into one governed data plane, preserving raw records and normalization steps for chain-of-custody. Instant Graph Construction Volumez Agentic Infrastructure can materialize and update a social graph in-place as data arrives—relationships such as shared device, co-location, reply chains, and account handoffs—so agents can traverse multi-hop links immediately rather than waiting for overnight builds. Semantic Forensics Volumez Agentic Infrastructure applies vector-based indexing to images and text so agents can discover non-obvious connections—visual similarities, recurring motifs, or paraphrased phrases—that keyword search misses, while keeping the evidence linked to the original artifact. The "Unsolvable" Join Volumez Agentic Infrastructure joins unstructured chat content with structured geolocation and telecom events using time-windowed correlation and identity resolution. This collapses investigation time from weeks to hours, enabling fast targeting with explainable reasoning paths. Take agentic to a whole new level. Visual Logic Volumez Agentic Infrastructure vectorizes inspection photos and technician images, enabling semantic search for subtle visual cues (e.g., discoloration, misalignment) that are difficult to encode in structured fields and easy to miss with SQL-only approaches. Correlate card payments, ACH/wires, account logins, device fingerprints, and customer communications to identify the ring leader and block losses before funds irreversibly leave the network. The agent must act in seconds—while producing an auditor-ready explanation of every action taken. The Challenge Split Evidence Fraud signals are fragmented across transaction rails (cards, RTP, ACH, wires), identity systems (KYC/CRM), security telemetry (logins, devices, IPs), and communications (chat, email, call transcripts). The hardest part is joining these sources fast enough to be useful—without losing traceability. Graph Speed vs. Compliance Modern fraud is relational: mule accounts, shared devices, synthetic identities, and coordinated timing. Graph analytics can surface this, but many pipelines are batch-based and produce stale results. Meanwhile, regulators and risk teams require explainability—why a customer was blocked, and which evidence justified it. Unstructured Blind Spots Critical indicators often hide in PDFs and free text: onboarding documents, dispute narratives, SAR notes, support chats, and email threads. Keyword search misses paraphrases and code words, and manual review is too slow. High-Volume, Low-Latency Reality Payment networks operate at massive event rates with tight SLAs. Traditional pipelines treat these as attachments, not searchable data. Time-Critical Risk Windows Wildfire and outage risk is driven by rapidly changing conditions (wind shifts, heat, load spikes). Provenance and Accountability Utilities must justify mitigation actions and operational changes.
